product_markets.name: Heat-pump smart controls / compatibility specialist

product_markets.thesis: Installed-base transition is strong, but generic merchant gap is weak: tado sells DTC and Homely has an installer/distributor channel. Only model-specific compatibility or underserved control components should survive.

product_markets.name: Plug-in / balcony solar kits after August 2026 legalization
product_markets.thesis: The regulatory shock creates real demand, but major UK retailers are entering immediately and compliance limits are material. Generic kit dropshipping is not a defensible GeoDrop gap.
product_markets.next_action: Keep ecosystem alive but kill generic kit thesis; monitor seller/price compression and discover post-install monitoring/mounting/compatibility jobs.

product_markets.name: Tesla Model Y exact-fitment accessory store
exact_skus: Model Y 2026 RWD exact-fitment bundle archetype
product_markets.thesis: EV stock growth is real but the generic Model Y specialist gap is falsified by established UK exact-fitment merchants. Re-run installed-base lag only on newly scaling makes/models.
product_markets.next_action: Use DfT make/model stock to rank fast-growing EV cohorts, excluding models with mature UK specialists before search-spend tests.

product_markets.name: Problem-led damp / heat-loss diagnostic kits
product_markets.thesis: The potential wedge is a problem-led diagnostic assortment (moisture/humidity/thermal) tied to old-home jobs and regional risk, not a single thermal camera.
product_markets.next_action: Build exact problem→tool decision tree, measure native query clusters, and enumerate UK trade/DIY incumbents before choosing SKUs.
